== Biography ==
Walter was born about 1649. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3515|William Glasgow (1623-)]]<ref>https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-FWL</ref>
== Research Notes ==

=== Leithford household comparison — 17 October 2026 ===

The Walter buried on 4 June 1647 at Leithford is placed provisionally in William Glasgow-1087’s household at 68% subjective confidence. His burial transcript explicitly says son to William. The later Walter’s baptism repeats William and the exact Leithford residence and register reference, supporting one paternal household at 84%. Identifying its father with the Mid Calder William is a separate 68% inference, with another William of Leithford the principal rival. The documentary William father role is 98%; these are distinct scopes, not independent probabilities. No mother or infant age is assigned.

Both 23 September 1647 and 23 September 1649 baptism readings follow the June burial. Keep the two record accounts separate pending original-year verification; this is consistent with name reuse, without proving two distinct sons. The source-verification hold remains. This later working selection supersedes earlier advice to leave the burial father wholly unselected; his identity remains unproved.<ref>Findmypast/SGS burial SCOT/OPR/BUR/1625437, 4 June 1647, Leithford, OPR 689/20, https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBUR%2F1625437; baptism SCOT/OPR/BAP/4473489, indexed 23 September 1647, same residence/reference, https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4473489. Supplied ScotlandsPeople OPR 690/10/19 and FamilySearch https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-FWL give 23 September 1649. William’s 1609 Mid Calder christening: https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1B2-3LV. Maintained readings reused; originals uninspected.</ref>
